driverInstallation.windows: Download Epson WorkForce Pro WF-C5890 driver from epson.com/support. Run installer and select network connection. Driver auto-discovers or enter IP. Install full package for scan and fax features. Includes Epson Scan 2 utility.
driverInstallation.mac: Download macOS driver from epson.com or use AirPrint. Install PKG file and add via System Preferences > Printers & Scanners. Epson Scan 2 app provides scanning functionality.
driverInstallation.linux: Download Linux driver from Epson or use built-in CUPS driver. Epson provides DEB and RPM packages. Configure via CUPS at localhost:631. Most features supported.
